name: air-surveillance-radar
label: Air surveillance radar (terminal / en route)
description: A rotating primary radar watching aircraft: about 4 s a revolution, over 100 km, fast and manoeuvring targets.
basis: Benchmark, opensky-radar (OpenSky ADS-B as truth, simulated radars at Heathrow and Manchester: 4 s, 50 m and 0.15 deg, Pd 0.9).
